claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby, a city that has railways in its DNA.

entities.name: Andy Burnham
entities.role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

claims.quote: This will bring investment and good jobs, giving young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.
claims.statement: The Derby headquarters will bring investment and good jobs and give young people the chance to build their future in the place they call home.

claims.quote: The biggest shake-up to our railways in a generation is underway.
claims.statement: The biggest shake-up to the railways in a generation is underway.

claims.quote: With 600 apprenticeships opening up, we’re investing not just in the railway of tomorrow, but in the people who will build it.
claims.statement: Government is investing in the people who will build the railway of tomorrow through 600 apprenticeships.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: The foundation apprenticeship forms part of a £2.5 billion youth employment support package creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: This is fantastic news for Derby.
claims.statement: Locating Great British Railways in Derby is fantastic news for the city.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will be based here, bringing hundreds of jobs into the city
claims.statement: Great British Railways being based in Derby will bring hundreds of jobs into the city.

claims.quote: an estimated £151 million boost to the region’s economy
claims.statement: The new headquarters is estimated to give the region’s economy a £151 million boost.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of the Great British Railways headquarters was unveiled in Derby on 15 October 2026.

facts.quote: Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre
facts.statement: The headquarters site is Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre.

facts.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
facts.statement: The headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 Great British Railways staff.

facts.quote: delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority
facts.statement: Better public transport links and walking routes around the site are being delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.
